# Swamp dweller's delight

Type: Feast | Internal ID: FeastSwamps_Material | Source: Food preparation table | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Sausages x8, Bloodbag x4, Turnip stew x2, Woodland herb blend x1 | Max Health: 35 | Max Stamina: 35 | Duration: 50m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Swamp dweller's delight is the Swamp-tier Feast.

## Recipe

Swamp dweller's delight can be produced at a Food preparation table with:
• Sausages x8
• Bloodbag x4
• Turnip stew x2
• Woodland herb blend x1
The Woodland herb blend is only sold after The Elder has been defeated.

Categorias: Food, Feast
